name: Masou Shojo ~Zettai Shihai no Carnaval~
original_name: 魔装処女 ～絶対支配のカルナバル～
source:
The protagonist, who is a student at the best magic school in Japan "Babel", is a successor of a family of black magicians, thus having the power to absorb others' magical power. Moreover, he also can use demonic magic, albeit crudely.

On the surface, the reason for his enrollment to Babel is to strengthen his own magic and revive his family's sorcery. However, the truth is that, whenever he uses absorption, he feels immense pleasure, and his opponent also becomes more aroused. The stronger the magic, the stronger the effect.

"What will happens if I absorb magical power from the strongest magicians?"

And his targets are the top 3 students: childhood friend - Nao, discipline committee leader - Reika, and student council president - Amane.

[Translated from [url=http://www.crossover-soft.jp/crs010.php#STORY]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主人公就读于日本最好的魔法学校“巴别塔”，是黑魔法师家族的继承人，拥有吸收他人魔力的力量。此外，他还会使用恶魔魔法，虽然技巧粗糙。

表面上，他进入巴别塔是为了强化自身魔法，复兴家族秘术。然而，真相是，每当他吸收魔力，就会感到极大快感，对手也会变得更加兴奋。魔力越强，效果越强。

“如果我从最强的魔法师那里吸收魔力，会发生什么？”

他的目标是3名顶尖学生：青梅竹马奈绪、纪律委员长玲香，以及学生会长天音。

[译自[url=http://www.crossover-soft.jp/crs010.php#STORY]官方网站[/url]]
